description: This file contains functions and logic for handling NAND flash upgrades in OpenWrt, including identifying, verifying, attaching/detaching UBI, creating/removing volumes, and performing firmware upgrades for NAND devices.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a UBI volume based on directory info.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds a UBI volume by name within a given UBI device.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device associated with a given partition.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads magic number from NAND device.

methods.name: get_magic_long_tar
methods.description: Reads magic number from tar archive.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the type of NAND device or image based on magic number.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the type of tar archive based on magic number.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if a file is gzip compressed.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from backup to UBI volume.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes a UBI block device.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI device to a partition.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI device from a partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for upgrade, creating/removing volumes as needed.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Writes a ubinized UBI image to the device.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Writes a UBIFS image to the UBI volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Writes a FIT image to the UBI kernel volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Extracts and writes images from a tar archive to partitions/volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies gzip compressed file integrity.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies tar archive integrity.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Identifies and upgrades firmware files based on type.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration if backup exists.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform firmware upgrade process.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Handles successful upgrade cleanup and reboot.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles failed upgrade cleanup and reboot.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if a firmware file is valid for upgrade on this platform.
